problem_statement: Receiver-based Orchestra with RPL non-storing routing can strand packets after a TSCH time-source change: the scheduler still selects a cell for a destination that remains a neighbor, but its transmit link has disappeared. Changing or losing the time source must preserve usable transmit scheduling and queued traffic for nodes that remain neighbors. Neighbor removal must still remove the associated transmit link and clean up queued traffic. Time-source changes must not create unicast cells for nodes absent from the neighbor set. Preserve neighbor addition, packet selection, local receive scheduling, and unrelated neighbors.
orientation: Component tests link real Orchestra dispatch, the non-storing unicast rule, packetbuf, and TSCH schedule storage. Queue, locking, logging and root-rule boundaries are scripted. `run_tests` rebuilds and runs focused regressions and unchanged upstream data-structure controls. The upstream Cooja regression is preserved under tests/ but is not run by this component runner. Tests under tests/ are protected.
